title: BitMap16 DX
summary: Draw tiny pixel art, collect palettes, and export your sketches.
description:
BitMap16 DX is a tiny pixel-art sketchbook for Cardputer ADV and Cardputer Zero, channeling the vibe of 2000s handheld game consoles.

Create pixel art on 8×8, 16×16, or 32×32 canvases. Draw, erase, and fill, with zoom, a pixel-accurate minimap, and 16-step undo and redo. Choose built-in palettes, swap colors, or browse the daily Lospec feed and import by name or URL. Preview your sketches in a slideshow, and export PNGs at 128×128 or their original size.
